card.name: Point where a sentence can add more
card.fires_on: Words or punctuation, often an opening parenthesis or comma, that come right after a complete clause in general web prose. The writer is about to add an extra item, aside or continuation.

modes.description: A word ending one item in a run of parallel items, before the next one.

card.writes: It slightly favors Chinese and Korean words meaning "not only" or "both X and", and disfavors example-introducing words like "such as".
card.plain: It fires at the spot where a writer could keep going with an added item, aside or extra clause.
